mapper.select: select record_id, account_id, order_id, cost, create_time, is_pay, is_refund from fund_order_record where account_id=#{accountId} order by record_id desc limit #{start},#{need}

select record_id, account_id, order_id, order_description, cost, deadline, able_rollback_time, create_time, is_pay, is_refund from fund_order_record where record_id=#{recordId} and account_id=#{accountId}
select order_id from fund_order_record where record_id=#{recordId} and account_id=#{accountId} and now() > able_rollback_time and is_pay=true and is_refund=false
mapper.update: update fund_order_record set is_pay=true where record_id=#{recordId} and now() < deadline and is_pay=false and is_refund=false
mapper.select: select record_id from fund_order_record where order_id=#{orderId}
